title: Canonical Contents remaining-scope production-owner applicability audit
question: Do the canonical Contents areas not covered by R-459 contain a standalone file that supplies the complete Q3/A13 production-owner vocabulary under the same bounded alternate-terminology contract?
method: Scan only the operator-configured canonical Contents residual roots Backup, Codes, Runs, Website, and the remaining Docs/Github paths; exclude Docs/math, Github/note, Docs/status and Github/status already audited by R-459; search .txt, .md and .tex only.

Apply the unchanged strict field-boundary aliases for generator/transfer or Markov semigroup, heat-root/heat-kernel or heat-semigroup, filtration/conditional replica or replica, raw-current/current spatial or spatial intertwiner, and q-ledger/q_k ledger/one-use q/nonnegative q ledger.
Check exact R-192 owner tokens separately, retain path and raw-content SHA-256 counts, and classify merged bundles and partial rows as discovery/reference material rather than owner evidence.

Run the primary scanner, a non-importing independent reconstruction, an integrated verifier, and hostile mutations that remove groups or attempt merged-bundle, loose-phrase, scope, or promotion acceptance.
finding: The strict complementary residual scan covers 284 paths and 273 unique content hashes, with 11 duplicate paths. It finds zero complete semantic paths, zero standalone owner candidates, and zero exact R-192 owner-token paths. Three partial paths contain at least three groups and no loose-q control row is present. Primary and independent summaries agree, the integrated verifier passes 17/17 assertions, and the hostile lane rejects 8/8 mutations.
decision_reason: R-459 deliberately audited Docs/math, Github/note, Docs/status and Github/status. This additive audit closes the complementary residual roots with the same aliases and de-duplication rules, preventing an unexamined Codes, Runs, Website, Backup or remaining Docs/Github path from being mistaken for a source boundary. No existing research method, owner order or promotion firewall is changed.
decision_scope: T0 read-only canonical-Contents residual source-applicability and terminology-boundary audit; no dynamics, candidate, observation score, physical identification, theorem, or tier transition.
evidence_level: T0 exact read-only canonical-Contents residual-scope alias scan with path/content-hash deduplication; no model execution
assumptions: The operator-configured Contents root is the maintained canonical source tree for this residual audit.
